freshness.label: Fills
freshness.tip: Closed round trips from schwab_round_trips (built from the broker transaction ledger every 15 min in market hours). A sell that is not in the ledger yet is not shown as closed.

freshness.label: Holdings
freshness.tip: Open positions from the holdings_accounts store (lib.portfolio_positions, the one accessor). Its as_of is shown; a stop that filled after it is flagged.

freshness.label: Stops
freshness.tip: Observed stop orders from stop_last_known — one durable row per stop order the scan saw, with the time it was captured. Stop levels are reference facts, never orders.

freshness.label: CIO
freshness.tip: Conviction, rank and stance from the CIO opportunity book (cio_opportunity_projection + its append-only history).

freshness.label: Re-entry desk
freshness.tip: The deterministic re-entry desk snapshot — the same record the Watch page's Re-entry near lane reads. No model sets READY / NEAR / BLOCK.

freshness.label: Origin links
freshness.tip: Recommendation → trade links (learning loop PR1: recommendation_registry + trade_recommendation_links). Without them, origin falls back to the CIO opportunity history and CIO entry calls.

freshness.label: Record
freshness.tip: AGENTS.md §26: pages read the CIO prospect record through its projection. Until that store is live this page uses an interim adapter over today's sources with the identical shape.
